name: Crude Oil EIA Inventory Reaction
description: Measures how crude oil (CL) moves around the weekly EIA petroleum inventory report released Wednesdays at 10:30 ET. Computes average absolute % move at 1, 5, 15, and 30 minutes after release using 1-min bars. Outputs: bar chart of avg reaction by horizon, histogram of 1-min move distribution, and event markers for each release.
source:
# Crude Oil EIA Inventory Report Reaction Study
# EIA releases Wednesdays at 10:30 ET — proxy via day_of_week + time_of_day
# Measures absolute % move at +1, +5, +15, +30 min after release

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1Min)()
cont = futures_continuation(timeframe=1Min, s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c

# --- Event Detection: Wednesday 10:30 ET ---
is_wed = day_of_week(weekday=Weekday.Wednesday)()
ts = index()
tod = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.time_of_day, timezone='America/New_York')(ts)
is_1030 = tod == 630
is_eia_bar = is_wed and is_1030

# --- Forward Returns at +1, +5, +15, +30 min ---
fwd_1m = forward_returns(period=1)(close)
fwd_5m = forward_returns(period=5)(close)
fwd_15m = forward_returns(period=15)(close)
fwd_30m = forward_returns(period=30)(close)

# Isolate to EIA release bars only
eia_fwd_1m = where(is_eia_bar, fwd_1m)
eia_fwd_5m = where(is_eia_bar, fwd_5m)
eia_fwd_15m = where(is_eia_bar, fwd_15m)
eia_fwd_30m = where(is_eia_bar, fwd_30m)

# Absolute moves (magnitude regardless of direction)
abs_1m = abs(eia_fwd_1m)
abs_5m = abs(eia_fwd_5m)
abs_15m = abs(eia_fwd_15m)
abs_30m = abs(eia_fwd_30m)

# --- Output 1: Bar Chart — Avg Absolute Move by Horizon ---
# THE PUNCHLINE: How big is the reaction, and does it grow over 30 min?
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='How Big Is the EIA Reaction?',
    category='EIA Reaction',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=False,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1 Min', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5 Min', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+15 Min', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+30 Min', color=Color.Violet)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(abs_1m, abs_5m, abs_15m, abs_30m))

# --- Output 2: Histogram — Distribution of 1-Min Moves ---
# Shows the spread of immediate reactions (signed, not absolute)
histogram(
    title='Distribution of 1-Min Moves After EIA',
    category='EIA Reaction',
    bins=30,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_analytics=True,
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(value=eia_fwd_1m)

# --- Output 3: Event Markers — Each EIA Release ---
# Click to navigate to each Wednesday 10:30 release bar
eia_close = where(is_eia_bar, close)
eia_signed_1m = where(is_eia_bar, fwd_1m)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='EIA Inventory Release',
        icon=Icon.BarChartIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='1-Min Move', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='5-Min Move', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='CL Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='30-Min Move', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(eia_signed_1m, eia_fwd_5m, eia_close, eia_fwd_30m, is_eia_bar)
